Q: Why is my message not comitted to the backout queue? A:

Before delivering a message to an application, MQ JMS library processes message headers. If it can not process, the message is not removed from the queue. The message gets delivered again and MQ JMS again processes the message and if it fails, the message remains in the queue. Every time the message is delivered, the BackoutCount property of the message is incremented. To avoid repeated delivery of a message, BOQNAME and BOTHRESH properties are defined for a queue.

When a message is delivered, MQ JMS looks at the BackoutCount. If the BackoutCount is greater than BPOTHRESH, then the message is routed to the queue defined in BOQNAME. This allows next good message in a queue can be delivered to an application.

You may want to check the BOTHRESH set on the queue and bakcoutcount of the message.

Q: React app not re-loading while changes in any file of app A:

In some cases running
npm run webpack -- --watch

may help as a temporary measure.

Q: Where can I find php-fpm.log and php-fpm.conf on my server? A:

In /opt/cpanel/ea-php73/root/etc/php-fpm.conf I found this line:

error_log = /opt/cpanel/ea-php73/root/usr/var/log/php-fpm/error.log

I see the error log files there:

root@jai [/opt/cpanel/ea-php73/root/usr/var/log/php-fpm]# pwd
/opt/cpanel/ea-php73/root/usr/var/log/php-fpm
root@jai [/opt/cpanel/ea-php73/root/usr/var/log/php-fpm]# ls -al
total 151456
drwxrwx--- 2 nobody root     4096 Apr 14 17:36 ./
drwxr-xr-x 3 root   root     4096 Mar 26 04:42 ../
-rw------- 1 root   root 31536068 Apr 17 17:05 error.log
-rw------- 1 root   root 32102325 Mar 29 03:26 error.log-20200329
-rw------- 1 root   root 51453659 Apr  5 03:36 error.log-20200405
-rw------- 1 root   root 39966549 Apr 12 02:55 error.log-20200412
root@jai [/opt/cpanel/ea-php73/root/usr/var/log/php-fpm]#

Q: How to move the cursor in a DataGridView? A:

I'm not sure this will give you what you want, but you can change the selection background and foreground colors to negate the normal, default appearance of a cell being selected. Get the DataGridViewCell Style property. Then change the Style's SelectionBackColor and SelectionForeColor.

Q: Running into build wheel error installing specific version of Frida, unsure how to proceed A:

I believe frida 12.2.1 requires Python 3.6 or 3.7. I tested the code below and it worked on Python 3.6.

If you do require an older Python version, StableBuild maintains historic copies of Deadsnakes PPA (free, but requires registration). You can pin the Python version e.g. in a Docker container via:

FROM ubuntu:20.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ARG SB_API_KEY=... 
ARG APT_PIN_DATE=2025-04-14T10:40:01Z

COPY ./sb-apt.sh /opt/sb-apt.sh
RUN bash /opt/sb-apt.sh load-apt-sources ubuntu deadsnakes

RUN apt update && apt install -y python3.6 python3.6-distutils wget
RUN wget https://bootstrap.pypa.io/pip/3.6/get-pip.py && python3.6 get-pip.py

# frida 12.2.1's setup.py asks PyPI over XMLRPC for this egg and that API is gone.
# Putting it in $HOME under this exact name allows for the installer to retrieved it offline.
RUN wget -O "$HOME/frida-12.2.1-py3.6-linux-x86_64.egg" https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/9a/55/ffe3563cb4c9aeb7b4b5b5d0404b900af662673b64edadac2b3916195884/frida-12.2.1-py3.6-linux-x86_64.egg

RUN pip3.6 install frida==12.2.1

sb-apt.sh can be downloaded on the 'Ubuntu repository' tab in the StableBuild dashboard (where you can get your API key).

Please note the work around to get the frida egg, as PyPI does not support XMLRPC as of now, so we need to directly download it.
